title: Welcome to Becoming, by Stan
subtitle: A coming-of-age story.
excerpt: The first note from Becoming, by Stan.
body:
Welcome to Becoming, by Stan.

This is a personal digital diary about all the little things I enjoy. As I'm growing, and in other terms: adulting, my person is getting shaped by the world around me. I've always lived in it without questioning wether it was the kind of human being I wanted to become, until now. .

More stories coming soon.
